about: Kewal Kiran Clothing Limited was incorporated in 1992. The Company is engaged in manufacturing, marketing and retailing of branded readymade garments and finished accessories. The company has consumers in Asia, Middle East and CIS (Commonwealth of Independent States). Its registered office is in Mumbai. [1] [2]
